CommunityApplications.Profile:
Self-hosted aggregators for Unraid. Each app pulls a category of thing you would otherwise search for across a dozen sites, and puts it behind one search box on your own server.
**Shopping Hub** - cross-marketplace product aggregation. Crawls AliExpress, Alibaba, DHgate, Banggood, Made-in-China, Geekbuying, Chinavasion and eBay, works out which listings are the *same physical product*, and gives you one page per product with every site's price, minimum order quantity and disclosed shipping, translated to English. It compares on **landed cost** (unit price x MOQ + freight + duty) rather than sticker price, because the cheapest unit price routinely belongs to the most expensive order, and it includes a US retail baseline so it can tell you when importing is not actually worth it.
**AoNarr** - a self-hosted media manager covering every library the individual *arr apps split across separate containers (movies, TV, anime, music, books, audiobooks, comics, manga, and more) in one app, one database, one container. Same core mechanics as Sonarr/Radarr/Lidarr/Readarr - quality profiles, indexers, download clients, notifications, calendar - plus extras like an OPDS catalog, subtitle management, IRC instant-grab feeds and Plex/Jellyfin/Emby sync, all built in rather than bolted on as separate containers.
**MC-Mod-Hub** is in progress and will appear here when its template is ready: a Minecraft mod search hub spanning Modrinth, CurseForge and others.
All of them are MIT licensed. Issues and questions are handled on GitHub, on each app's own repository.
